answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and joins a Semaphore identity tree, then evaluates a committed polynomial whose rate-limited shares bind each authorized message to a nullifier. If it sends duplicate messages, the resulting Shamir shares reveal enough information to reconstruct its private key; the network verifies the proof and instantly slashes its collateral. Thus a jetty, comet, or pulse of Sybil identities cannot multiply voting power safely.
